_note: Hand-written camera direction for cards that must stand apart from others in their group. Keys: composition (shot and angle), palette (light and colour). Anything not set comes from the planner in composition.py.

leon.composition: a dignified heroic portrait seen from a very low angle, Leonidas standing tall against an enormous sky, his red cloak streaming in the wind
leon.palette: deep crimson sunset with golden rim light
leon.power: larger than life, monumental and iconic

hopl.composition: seen from behind and slightly above: the back of an ordinary soldier standing in a long line of identical round shields, the plain stretching ahead

spear.composition: a tight close-up of the spearman's face under a plain bronze helmet, eyes narrowed, the spear's leaf-shaped tip sharp in the foreground

capt.composition: a waist-up side profile of the captain with his mouth open shouting an order, sword pointing out of the frame

sent.composition: a silhouette of the sentinel seen from below against a starry sky, standing on top of the earth wall beside his tall shield
sent.palette: deep night blue with a single watch-fire glow

gate.composition: at eye level, the guard framed in the black gateway, the two carved lionesses above lit by torchlight from below

ajax.composition: from a low angle, Ajax filling the frame behind his enormous tower shield, only his eyes and helmet crest showing above its rim

peltast.composition: a full figure caught side-on in mid-leap as he hurls a javelin, dust kicking up

veteran.composition: an extreme close-up of an old soldier's scarred, grey-bearded face

pikeman.composition: head-on at eye level, the long pike's point aimed straight at the viewer, the guard behind it

medic.composition: a close-up of the surgeon's hands binding a wounded leg, his face in lamplight behind

brasidas.composition: a three-quarter figure from slightly below, a column of marching men behind him

owl.composition: an extreme close-up of the owl's face, its huge golden eyes filling the frame

iris.composition: a full figure seen from below, gliding diagonally down a rainbow toward the viewer
iris.palette: prismatic rainbow colours against storm grey

achil.composition: at a dramatic tilted angle, Achilles caught in a great leap, his divine armour blazing, spear held high above his head

pent.composition: from a very low angle, Penthesilea on a rearing horse monumental above us, double axe raised
pent.palette: storm light with a flash of lightning

agam.composition: Agamemnon seated on a high throne seen from below, sceptre across his knees, looking down at the viewer

zerk.composition: an extreme close-up of the berserker's screaming face, bloodshot eyes

dio2.composition: over the shoulder from behind Diomedes as he drives his spear at the towering war god ahead of him

thess.composition: a side view of a horse at full gallop filling the frame, the rider low over its neck

corsair.composition: from a low angle on the sand, the raider leaping out of his boat toward the viewer, spray flying

harrier.composition: from the ship's prow, the raider looking back over his shoulder as he blows a horn, boats racing behind

reaver.composition: a close-up of hands dipping arrowheads into a clay pot of poison, the face hidden in shadow

ram.composition: seen from the side at night, the crew straining at the ram under a wooden roof

helios.composition: Helios driving his blazing chariot straight at the viewer, the horses' fiery heads filling the frame

nike.composition: from below, Nike swooping down toward the viewer, her wings spread across the whole frame

eury.composition: a head-and-shoulders portrait of Eurylochus at eye level, wary, gripping his sword in a dark forest

cerb.composition: the three heads fill the entire frame, lunging at the viewer with jaws open
cerb.palette: underworld green and black with ember-red eyes

hades.composition: Hades enthroned, seen from a very low angle, a colossal dark figure with crown and two-pronged staff, pale shades tiny at his feet
hades.palette: underworld green and black with cold light

iph.composition: a close-up of Iphigenia's calm face under a white veil, the glowing eyes of a deer behind her

thanat.composition: from below, Thanatos with great dark wings spread across the frame, his face serene

mino.composition: the Minotaur's horned head filling the frame, nostrils flaring
mino.palette: torchlight from one side in deep shadow

charon.composition: a close-up of Charon's gaunt face and his bony outstretched hand holding a coin toward the viewer

argus.composition: at ground level, close on the old dog's grey muzzle and eyes as he lifts his head toward his master

sphinx.composition: a close-up of the Sphinx's face with a knowing smile, her wings framing it

eagle.composition: the eagle diving straight at the viewer, talons and thunderbolt first

tbull.composition: the white bull surging out of the waves toward the viewer, water streaming off its shoulders

cass.composition: a close-up of Cassandra's anguished face, eyes wide, the wooden horse a dark silhouette behind her
cass.palette: red glow of a burning city

telem.composition: seen from behind, Telemachus at the prow looking out to the horizon, the sail filling the top of the frame

pythia.composition: a close-up of the Pythia's face wreathed in vapour, eyes rolled up in trance

herm.composition: Hermes in flight seen from below, his winged sandals large in the foreground

siren.composition: a close-up of the Siren's face and her great spread wings, mouth open in song

song.composition: a side profile of a Siren perched high on a ship's mast, singing, silver ripples of sound in the air, the ship's deck far below

scout.composition: seen from behind, a small Siren crouched on a crag in the foreground, watching a tiny ship far below

eel.composition: the eel's open jaws filling the frame, lunging at the viewer

poly.composition: an extreme close-up of the Cyclops' single huge eye and snarling face filling the frame

brute.composition: a full figure from a low angle, the brute swinging his club down toward the viewer

elder.composition: a side profile of the old Cyclops, his single eye half-closed, long beard

cscout.composition: seen from behind, the herder standing on a hilltop above his flocks
cscout.palette: green hills under a pale sky

cave.composition: two glowing eyes in the dark mouth of a cave, the beast's shape barely visible

scyl.composition: Scylla's six heads fill the entire frame, lunging at the viewer with jaws open; almost no background
scyl.palette: sea-cave darkness with cold green light

sh1.composition: a single serpentine head striking straight at the viewer, close on the jaws

sh2.composition: a head in side profile with its jaws shut tight, glaring eye in sharp focus, white sea spray bursting behind it

sh3.composition: the head seen in silhouette against a huge moon, its long neck arched, howling upward

sh4.composition: the green head coiled around a ship's broken mast, venom dripping onto the deck

heads.composition: from the ship's deck far below, the six long necks rising out of the cliff cave into the mist

chary.composition: the whirlpool seen from directly above, a spiral of dark water filling the entire frame

whirl.composition: at water level, a curling wall of water at the whirlpool's rim towering over the viewer

clev.composition: the leviathan's huge eye and scaled flank filling the frame as it breaches

ceel.composition: the eel's long body curving in an S across the whole frame

hector.composition: a full figure from a very low angle, Hector monumental in gleaming armour, his tall horse-hair crest against the sky, spear held high

priam.composition: a close-up of old King Priam's lined face beneath his crown

circe.composition: a close-up of Circe's face as she looks up from her loom, golden eyes, wand raised

cwolf.composition: a close-up of the wolf's head, tongue out, fawning

clion.composition: the lion lying tame, seen at eye level from the ground, its huge face filling the frame

bull.composition: a head-on close-up of the bull's massive horned head with the sun disc between its horns

cow.composition: a side view of a sacred cow grazing, gilded horns

lamp.composition: seen from behind, her back to the viewer: Lampetia walking among the herd towards a huge setting sun, in silhouette

neith.composition: a close-up of Phaethusa's radiant face

sacril.composition: Helios' furious face filling the blazing sun disc, glaring down

shade1.composition: a single pale ghostly face emerging from darkness, close up

mourner.composition: seen from behind, a veiled ghost holding a withered rose

warden.composition: from a low angle, an armoured warden barring a gate with his spear

drill.composition: seen from directly above: rows of soldiers drilling in a square formation on pale sand, long morning shadows
drill.palette: cool morning blue-grey and pale sand

rally.composition: a close-up of a herald's face as he blows a great conch-shell horn, cheeks full, hair whipped by the wind

spoils.composition: a close-up of a heap of golden cups, coins and a bronze tripod with no people in the picture
spoils.palette: deep blue night with gold glints

plunder.composition: silhouettes of two raiders carrying a golden tripod out between a temple's columns into the night
plunder.palette: cold moonlit blue with one warm glow from inside

aegis.composition: the goatskin aegis with the Gorgon's face filling the frame, held out by Athena's hand
aegis.palette: bright marble white and gold daylight

banner.composition: a crimson banner seen from below, snapping against a huge pale dawn sky, no fire

dirge.composition: a lone bronze bell on a sea rock in the foreground, a Siren's silhouette small on a cliff far behind

cmaid.composition: seen from behind, the handmaid walking through a sunlit garden carrying a silver bowl

cwand.composition: a close-up of the golden wand's glowing tip touching a startled pig's snout; no human face in the picture

hmil.composition: seen from the side at dawn, an ordinary townsman in a simple cap, no helmet, on the city wall holding a spear and a small shield
hmil.palette: pale dawn blue and grey stone

hgua.composition: a full figure from a low angle, a huge armoured guard filling a dark gateway, his tall shield covering most of him

cbow.composition: seen from behind on a hilltop, the slinger whirling his sling above his head against a pale sky
cbow.palette: pale morning sky and green hills

mskirm.composition: a full figure seen from the side leaping over a low stone wall, sword drawn, hills behind
mskirm.palette: bright midday light on green hills
